title: Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
body:
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom Se Kehta Raha Mazloom Ka Beta
1. Sar god me bete ka hai aur baap ke naale
Ye kehke tadapte hai jawaa god ke paale
Dum ruktahai ab naade Ali dum karo baba
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai dardkaleje me meri rukti hai saansey
Beemar ki bekas ki tasawwur me hai aahey
Aankhao me mere phirti hai behna meri sughra
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mushkil thi padi sheh ne jigar par rakha pathar
Barchi pe rakha haat to tharra gaaya dilbar
Baba mera bahar na nikalaaye kalejaa
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shabbeer tadap kar Ali Akbar se ye bole
Aye laal mere kuch to zubaa se mujhe kehde
Bole Ali Akbar mere baba mere baba
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hichki jo lagi maut ki ronelage maulaa
Tharra gaya ek baar jawaa bete ka laashaa
Pyaase ne bus ek aah bhari ro ke pukaara
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zaqmi hai yaha noke sinaa se mera seena
Qaimey me na le jaaiiyye baba mera laasha
Ye dekhke mar jaayegi madar meri dukhyaa
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mayyat ke uthaane ko hue shaah jo ma’il
Sadme se jawaa laal ke beenayi thi za’il
Aijaaz fizaao me tha akbar ka ye nauhaa
<<MINI>>
Barchi Ki Anee Rehgayi Hai Seene Me Baba
